properties.entry: INSERT INTO membership_tbl ( member_id, ott_type, plan_name, expiry_date ) VALUES ( ?, ?, ?, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL ? DAY) )

SELECT membership_id, member_id, ott_type, plan_name, enroll_date, expiry_date, active FROM membership_tbl WHERE member_id = ? AND active = TRUE AND expiry_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY expiry_date, membership_id

SELECT membership_id, member_id, ott_type, plan_name, enroll_date, expiry_date, active FROM membership_tbl WHERE member_id = ? ORDER BY (active = TRUE AND expiry_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) DESC, expiry_date DESC, membership_id DESC
UPDATE membership_tbl SET expiry_date = DATE_ADD( GREATEST(expiry_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), INTERVAL ? DAY ), active = TRUE WHERE membership_id = ? AND member_id = ?
DELETE FROM membership_tbl WHERE membership_id = ? AND member_id = ?
SELECT DISTINCT ott_type, plan_name FROM membership_tbl WHERE member_id = ? ORDER BY ott_type, plan_name
